evidence.note: reading text at or above the text floor, labels at or above the label floor

rationale: Gate rule: rendered text px ≥ params.min_px_1920 (20) at ≥ 1920 wide, else ≥ params.min_px_1280 (15); labels (uppercase and tracked ≥ .05em, or a .cite/.quote-from source line) ≥ params.min_label_px_1920 (18) / params.min_label_px_1280 (12). No finding breaks it.
